description: Defines classes and interfaces for a data flow graph used in audio processing, including nodes, ports, input/output ports, source, sink, and filter classes within the flowgraph namespace.

classes.name: FlowGraphNode
classes.description: Base class for all nodes in the flowgraph, providing processing, data pulling, and reset functionalities.

classes.name: FlowGraphPort
classes.description: Abstract class representing a port for data flow, with subclasses for specific port types.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloat
classes.description: Port containing a buffer of float data, used for processing blocks of audio or data.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloatOutput
classes.description: Output port for float data, capable of connecting to input ports.

classes.name: FlowGraphPortFloatInput
classes.description: Input port for float data, can be connected to output ports or set values directly.

classes.name: FlowGraphSource
classes.description: Source node that outputs data without upstream dependencies.

classes.name: FlowGraphSourceBuffered
classes.description: Buffered source node that reads data from an external buffer.

classes.name: FlowGraphSink
classes.description: Sink node that consumes data, with a method to read data.

classes.name: FlowGraphFilter
classes.description: Processing node with input and output ports, typically for filtering or transforming data.

methods.name: pullData
methods.description: Pulls data through the node, managing upstream calls and recursion prevention.

methods.name: pullReset
methods.description: Recursively resets the graph starting from a sink node.

methods.name: onProcess
methods.description: Processes data for a node, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from a sink node, to be implemented by subclasses.
